name: Coeur d'Alene, ID
summary: A good town pick with bookable lodging. The lodging score now rests on both sides of a Sanders Beach duplex by Tubbs Hill (sharing only a driveway, main-floor king on each side), verified at US$1,450.33/night; Casago's historic 4BR across from McEuen Park plus a 1BR cottage, the better layout, is out because the cottage is booked for the trip nights while later July dates price (2026-11-15). Also bookable: a Fort Grounds 5BR by City Beach with Scott & Andrea in a resort Lake Tower room, verified at US$2,198.67/night; the Sherman Suite house and the historic guest house plus cottage are closed for the dates and sit in the backups. Animals are better than first thought: tiger feeding at Cat Tales (45 min) and sloth or capybara feeding at Big Red's Barn (15 min), both Thu-Sun only. Golf is good (the floating green, and Circling Raven 40 min away), and the NOAA July normal high is 83 F, 8 F over the target.

hard_constraints.notes: Airport: Spokane International (GEG) is about 40 min (roughly 35 miles on I-90, map estimate) from downtown Coeur d'Alene, inside the 90-min check. GEG carriers include United, Southwest, Alaska, Delta, American and Allegiant (airport site); DEN nonstops (United, Southwest) come from the earlier pass and were not re-verified, and Bay Area nonstops were not confirmed this pass. Seniors: downtown Coeur d'Alene is a flat lakefront grid (Sherman Ave, McEuen Park, City Park). The lodging score now rests on the Sanders Beach duplex: the parents have the main-floor king on the Vrbo 2183982 side, near Tubbs Hill and about 4 min on foot from McEuen Park; the lower bedrooms are down stairs, and the floors of the full baths and entry steps are not stated on the listing. The Casago Historic 4BR (main-floor king with en-suite) and the Sherman Suite (downstairs queen and bath) are sold out and sit in the backups. Tubbs Hill, Cat Tales and the golf outings are optional.

rationale.lodging: 15/25: rests on the Sanders Beach duplex, both sides (Vrbo 2183982 + 2183980), verified at US$1,450.33/night (fees included, well inside the cap), with a whole side for Scott & Andrea and a main-floor king for the parents, but stairs to the lower bedrooms, no stated dining seat count and a 10-min walk to Sherman Ave, below the Casago Historic 4BR + Cottage it replaced (that cottage is booked for the trip nights as of 2026-11-15).
rationale.town_scenery: 16/18: flat, walkable lakefront downtown with Sherman Avenue, McEuen Park, City Beach and Tubbs Hill all within about 10 min on foot of the recommended lodging; lake views are a short walk rather than from the house.
rationale.animals: 13/18: the top two are both exotic-animal feeding within 60 min, Cat Tales tiger feeding (8+, 45 min) and a Big Red's Barn sloth or capybara feed-and-pet session (8-10+, 15 min), with Cat Tales bear hand-feeding third; nothing lets the party do an activity with animals, both venues open Thu-Sun only, and the tiger feeding method is not described.
rationale.food: 14/15: well over 10 restaurants on Sherman Avenue and at the resort within about 5-10 min on foot, including Beverly's (7th floor of the resort, 14,000-bottle wine cellar) as the special dinner.
rationale.other: 8/10: Silverwood theme park, zip lines, lake cruises (including Fourth of July cruises), the resort spa and a pottery studio cover teens, crafts and spa; no escape room was found, and GEG is 40 min away but flight routes were not re-verified this pass.
rationale.golf: 8/9: the Coeur d'Alene Resort course with its floating 14th green, boat shuttle and forecaddies, plus Circling Raven (No. 1 public course in Idaho) about 40 min away; green fees are unpublished and non-guest access to the resort course is not stated.
rationale.weather: 1/5: Coeur d'Alene July normal high is 83 F (NOAA 1991-2020 via Current Results), 8 F over the 75 F target, so 20% of the weight; rain is light (0.7 in, 4 wet days).
